component.name: PageLite
component.summary: Edit Word documents in a fast, uncluttered window

description.p: PageLite opens, edits and saves Microsoft Word (.docx) files without the menus, ribbons and panels of a full office suite. It keeps the parts of a document it doesn't edit, such as comments, tracked changes, footnotes and fields, exactly as they were.

ul.li: Headings, bold, italic, underline, fonts, alignment and lists
Find, undo and redo, and Word-style keyboard shortcuts
Crash-safe saving, and a prompt before unsaved changes are lost
Works offline and never sends documents anywhere

description.p: First packaged release: open, edit and save .docx files, with formatting, find and shortcuts.
